company: Black Forest Labs was founded in 2024 by researchers behind Stable Diffusion. Its FLUX models generate and edit images and video and are licensed to companies including Adobe, Canva, Meta and Microsoft, as well as offered through platforms such as fal and Replicate.

In December 2025 the company raised a $300 million Series B led by Salesforce Ventures and Anjney Midha at a $3.25 billion post-money valuation, with a16z, Nvidia, General Catalyst and Temasek participating.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Black Forest Labs is Europe's leading generative-image company and a read-through for whether independent model makers can win by licensing to large software platforms.

changed.text: Black Forest Labs is founded by former Stable Diffusion researchers.
A $300M Series B values it at $3.25B.

takeaways: Licensing to big platforms gives it distribution without a large consumer app.
Its founders have a track record in image models.
Google and OpenAI offer strong competing image models.
Revenue depends on a small number of large partners.
